description: This file contains test utilities for shared channels and remote cluster synchronization in Mattermost, including HTTP handlers, response writers, and cleanup functions for testing environment setup.

classes.name: SelfReferentialSyncHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler for processing remote cluster sync messages in tests, with callbacks for posts and acknowledgements, and tracking message count.

methods.name: writeOKResponse
methods.description: Writes a standard OK JSON response for remotecluster.

methods.name: NewSelfReferentialSyncHandler
methods.description: Creates a new instance of SelfReferentialSyncHandler with initialized counters and callbacks.

methods.name: HandleRequest
methods.description: Processes incoming HTTP requests for sync messages, pings, and invites.

methods.name: GetSyncMessageCount
methods.description: Returns the number of sync messages received.

methods.name: EnsureCleanState
methods.description: Cleans up shared channels, remote clusters, user states, and resets services to ensure a clean test environment.
